patch_description: This version keeps the direct-demand reward compact and replaces the current collection of route, neighbor-profile, and reciprocal factors with a sparse set of demand-supported two-hop interactions. It ranks routes using endpoint affinity and transit pressure, chooses the third route using a demand quantile that is independent of route-strength scaling, and gives lower-ranked alternatives progressively smaller rewards. The route-strength factor increases mildly with network size to reduce the loss of predictor signal on larger instances. The evaluator still supplies all degree penalties.
